items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Curtis Counce. [INTERVIEWEE] Not significantly enough for the black guys.

ctx.x: I think so. The problem seemed to be that he didn’t have many black players coming through the band. There were some, Ernie Royal.
Not significantly enough for the black guys. I don’t know what disagreement Dizzy had with Stan but he really put him down strong.
